plan.notes: Source: HSU official 2026-2027 Degree Plans index, Associate of Science in Health Science, General (2026-2027 Catalog) PDF. Header states the plan is 'a suggested program of courses' and 'does not substitute for the HSU catalog'. Genuine term-by-term sequence sums 16+16+14+14 = 60. ENGL 10103 and ENGL 10203 require a grade of C or better. ENGL 10203 lists PR: ENG 1463, coded as plan-level external_prereqs (excluded from credit sums per standing rules). BIOL 10043 or BIOL 10103 is a choice slot (first-listed code shown); the separate 1-credit BIOL 10031 Introduction to Biology lab pairs with the choice. 'X or Y' choice slots use the first-listed code. ELECTIVE placeholders use code 'ELECTIVE' because the catalog names only the slot, not a course.
